title: Subgradient Gliding Method for Nonsmooth Convex Optimization
summary: We identify and analyze a fundamental limitation of the classical projected subgradient method in nonsmooth convex optimization: the inevitable failure caused by the absence of valid subgradients at boundary points. We show that, under standard step sizes for both convex and strongly convex objectives, the method can fail after a single iteration with probability arbitrarily close to one, even on simple problem instances.
